sentence: # Feasibility Study Company [1] Website Static marketing site for Feasibility Study Company, an independent feasibility and market-study practice serving lenders and investors (SBA, USDA, EB-5, HUD-FHA, and conventional institutional capital). ## Structure ``` / ├── index.html Home (self-contained; includes contact form) ├── asset-classes/ │ └── multifamily/index.html Multifamily & apartments coverage ├── states/ │ └── texas/index.html Texas market coverage ├── analytical-framework/index.html Methodology: how a study is built ├── tools/ │ └── nda/index.html Client-side NDA generator (jsPDF, noindex) ├── netlify/ │ └── functions/contact.js Serverless contact-form handler (Resend) ├── netlify.toml Netlify config (publish, functions, /api/contact rewrite) ├── 404.html Branded not-found page ├── styles.css Global stylesheet (design tokens + layout) ├── favicon.svg Brand monogram favicon ├── og.png 1200×630 social-share card ├── sitemap.xml Live, indexable URLs only ├── robots.txt Crawl directives + sitemap reference └── feed.xml RSS channel (Research Notes) ``` The site is intentionally launched with four published pages; primary-nav links to forthcoming sections (other states, asset classes, practice areas) resolve to the branded `404.html` until those pages ship.

No build step [1] the repository root is served as static assets, and `netlify/functions/` is deployed as serverless functions. - Build command: *(none)* - Publish directory: **/** (repository root) - Functions directory: **netlify/functions** ### Contact form The footer contact form posts to `/api/contact`, which `netlify.toml` rewrites to the `contact` function.
